name: mdx-fixture-graduation-contract
purpose: Define the draft step that turns a triaged finding into a proposed golden fixture for the Machine League regression floor, and reserve the human-curated graduation write that makes it binding.

states.meaning: A governed draft names a source finding receipt, a proposed fixture id, a scenario, the expected behavior, and a proposed family. It writes no registry entry and opens no allowlist.

Reserved for the sim program owner's human-curated graduation write that appends the fixture to the versioned registry, cites the source finding, and makes it a regression floor. Not implemented in this crate.

codex_owns: the graduation write (fixture.graduation.graduated) with human curation per docs/MDX-BETA-SIMULATION-PROGRAM.md
the Machine League Tier 3b re-measure trigger against graduated fixtures
